ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure is an op-amp Schmitt trigger; the triangular-wave input Vi is connected to the inverting terminal (−) of the op-amp. The non-inverting terminal (+) serves as a reference/summing node; this node is connected through three resistors labeled 10 kΩ respectively to the +15 V power supply, the −15 V power supply, and the output terminal V0. The problem also gives that the op-amp output saturation swing is from +15 V to −15 V. Reasoning: The op-amp input current is approximately 0, so write KCL at the non-inverting terminal node V+. The three resistors are equal, all 10 kΩ: (V+ − 15)/10k + (V+ + 15)/10k + (V+ − V0)/10k = 0. Combining gives: 3V+ − 15 + 15 − V0 = 0, so 3V+ = V0, that is, V+ = V0/3. Since the output V0 only switches between the two saturation values +15 V and −15 V, the non-inverting terminal voltages are respectively +15/3 = +5 V and −15/3 = −5 V. Therefore the switching levels of the non-inverting input terminal are between −5 V and +5 V.

raw_record.question_text: Consider the Schmidt trigger circuit shown below. A triangular wave that goes from -12 V to 12 V is applied to the inverting input of the OPAMP. Assume that the output of the OPAMP swings from +15 V to -15 V. Between what two voltages does the non-inverting input switch?

method.method_draft: Identify the non-inverting input as the summing/reference node connected by three equal 10 kΩ resistors to +15 V, -15 V, and V0. Since the op-amp input current is negligible, write KCL at the + input node: (V+ - 15)/10k + (V+ + 15)/10k + (V+ - V0)/10k = 0. Solve to get V+ = V0/3 because the +15 V and -15 V terms cancel. From the text, V0 saturates at +15 V or -15 V, so V+ takes +5 V or -5 V. Thus the non-inverting input switches between -5 V and +5 V.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一个运放施密特触发器，三角波输入 Vi 接到运放的反相端（−）。同相端（+）作为参考/求和节点；该节点通过三个标为 10 kΩ 的电阻分别连接到 +15 V 电源、−15 V 电源以及输出端 V0。题目还给出运放输出饱和摆幅为 +15 V 到 −15 V。

推理：运放输入电流近似为 0，因此在同相端节点 V+ 写 KCL。三个电阻相等，均为 10 kΩ：
(V+ − 15)/10k + (V+ + 15)/10k + (V+ − V0)/10k = 0。
合并得：3V+ − 15 + 15 − V0 = 0，所以 3V+ = V0，即 V+ = V0/3。由于输出 V0 只在 +15 V 和 −15 V 两个饱和值之间切换，所以同相端电压分别为 +15/3 = +5 V 和 −15/3 = −5 V。因此同相输入端的切换电平在 −5 V 和 +5 V 之间。

method.method_draft: Replace the two left-side 10 kΩ resistors between +15 V and -15 V, as seen from the non-inverting input node, by their Thevenin equivalent: Vth = 0 V and Rth = 5 kΩ. The feedback path from V0 to the same + input node is a 10 kΩ resistor. Therefore V+ is the divided fraction of V0 across the 5 kΩ Thevenin resistance: V+ = V0·5k/(10k + 5k) = V0/3. Since the problem states V0 swings to +15 V and -15 V, the + input reference levels are +5 V and -5 V. Hence it switches between -5 V and +5 V.

Image description: In the figure is an op-amp Schmitt trigger; the triangular-wave input Vi is connected to the inverting terminal (−) of the op-amp. The non-inverting terminal (+) serves as a reference/summing node; this node is connected through three resistors labeled 10 kΩ respectively to the +15 V power supply, the −15 V power supply, and the output terminal V0. The problem also gives that the op-amp output saturation swing is from +15 V to −15 V.

Reasoning: The op-amp input current is approximately 0, so write KCL at the non-inverting terminal node V+. The three resistors are equal, all 10 kΩ:
(V+ − 15)/10k + (V+ + 15)/10k + (V+ − V0)/10k = 0.
Combining gives: 3V+ − 15 + 15 − V0 = 0, so 3V+ = V0, that is, V+ = V0/3. Since the output V0 only switches between the two saturation values +15 V and −15 V, the non-inverting terminal voltages are respectively +15/3 = +5 V and −15/3 = −5 V. Therefore the switching levels of the non-inverting input terminal are between −5 V and +5 V.
